extracted.intended_audience: science writers and communicators (journalists, communicators, educators, and scientists); both new and practicing
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidance for writing, pitching, publishing, and investigating science stories across formats (essays, longform, multimedia, social media), plus career/practical skills for professional science communicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to structure a story
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on structuring a story to make it effective and engaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentioned as a topic covered by The Science Writers' Handbook: 'From how to structure a story...' — general instruction on story organization and flow for science journalism and narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing writer's perennial downfalls
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice for dealing with common writer problems such as envy, procrastination, and loneliness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The handbook addresses 'dealing with perennial writer's downfalls like envy, procrastination and loneliness' — practical strategies to maintain productivity and wellbeing as a writer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical career logistics for writers
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical, non-writing matters necessary for a writing career, e.g., health insurance and taxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The handbook covers career logistics: 'finding health insurance and doing your taxes' — guidance for managing the business and personal-administrative side of being a professional writer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitch, publish, and prosper (pitching & publishing skills)
rubrics_metrics.description: Skills and strategies for pitching stories, getting published, and building a successful career.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied by the book title and site resource 'Pitch Publish Prosper' — broad guidance on pitching, navigating publication markets, and career advancement for science writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize and develop essay ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques for identifying, shaping, and developing compelling essay ideas for science writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Essay Handbook: 'Recognize and develop essay ideas' — actionable help for idea generation and conceptual development specific to the essay form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and report for the essay form
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods for researching and reporting material that suit essays (as opposed to straight news), including source work and evidence-gathering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Essay Handbook: 'Research and report for the essay form' — guidance on tailoring reporting practices to narrative/reflective essay needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop a distinctive authorial voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Crafting and sustaining a recognizable, authentic voice appropriate for essays and personal science narratives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Essay Handbook: 'Develop a distinctive authorial voice' — emphasis on voice as a key element of successful essay writing and alternative to 'news voice.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Revise and polish essays for publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Revision, editing, and polishing practices to prepare essays for publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Essay Handbook: 'Revise and polish your essays for publication' — practical tips for editing drafts to meet publication standards and fit target outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply essay-writing skills across formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Adapting essay techniques to varied story forms, including longform narratives, multimedia productions, and social-media posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Essay Handbook: 'Apply your essay-writing skills to stories of all kinds, from longform narratives to multimedia productions to social-media posts' — guidance on cross-format adaptability of essay craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Launch science-based investigations
rubrics_metrics.description: How to initiate and plan investigations focused on science-related accountability reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Investigative Reporting Handbook: 'Launch science-based investigations' — step-by-step guidance for starting investigative projects in science journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivate sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques for finding, developing, and maintaining reliable sources for investigative and explanatory reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Investigative Reporting Handbook: 'Cultivate sources' — practical strategies for source development and relationship management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose an investigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and decision-making for selecting which science-related issues or stories are worth investigating.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Investigative Reporting Handbook: 'Choose an investigation' — guidance on topic selection and assessing newsworthiness/impact for investigative work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work with data and organize materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods for handling, analyzing, and organizing data and other materials during investigations and reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Investigative Reporting Handbook: 'Work with data and organize materials' — practical advice on data handling and evidence organization to support investigative stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bulletproof stories to avoid legal and ethical pitfalls
rubrics_metrics.description: Practices to reduce legal and ethical risk in investigative and other reporting (fact-checking, documentation, legal awareness).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From The Science Writers' Investigative Reporting Handbook: 'Bulletproof stories to avoid legal and ethical pitfalls' — explicit attention to legal/ethical safety in reporting to prevent defamation, privacy, or other issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply skeptical accountability reporting to science
rubrics_metrics.description: Approach investigative science coverage with the same skepticism applied to other human endeavors to ensure accountability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page asserts: 'The Science Writers' Investigative Reporting Handbook makes a timely case for why journalists should cover science with the same skepticism they would bring to any other human endeavor.' — normative criterion for investigative stance and skepticism in science reporting.
